Method of Attack: Used bundled malware to harvest sensitive info including account authentication to hijack WhatsApp accounts and send spam messages
Prompted victims to enter WhatsApp user credentials and authenticated WhatsApp access on malicious apps
Communicated user's credentials to WhatsApp's computers to obtain account keys and authentication information
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps available for download from company sites and third-party app stores including Google Play Store, APK Pure, APKSFree, iDescargar, and Malavida
Indicators of Compromise: Apps including AppUpdater for WhatsPlus 2021 GB Yo FM HeyMods and Theme Store for Zap
Google Play Store entry showing over one million installs for AppUpdater for WhatsPlus
Malicious apps offered outside of Google Play from developer HeyMods including Hey WhatsApp
